title: Oral Immunotherapy for Peanut and Mammalian Meat Allergies
brief_summary: Pilot study to assess the effect of oral immunotherapy on specific Immunoglobulin E (IgE) levels and antigen consumption in two distinct food allergies.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Presence or absence of specific IgE to alpha-gal or peanut

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of severe anaphylaxis
* allergy to cow's milk protein
